newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Sept 19.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Sept 19.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:
* The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd A$15.72 (-0.28)

Shares in market bellwhether has been suffering from weak commodity prices, but a strong rise in the copper price overnight is seen pushing up BHP, the world's second largest copper producer up. The stock was quoted higher in pre-market open bids.

Shares in casino operator rose on Wednesday as rumours that Australia's richest man Kerry Packer is keen to acquire the Sydney casino group after selling down his stake in Melbourne casino operator Crown Ltd on Tuesday.
Large trade in Crown shares before market opened today, despite brokers saying that Packer's stake has been sold on.

Large trade in television group on Wednesday caused share price to jump and there are further big trades before Thursday open. The Sydney Morning Herald reported today that chairman Kerry Stokes was behind the buying on Wednesday.
Shares in nickel explorer hit record high on Wednesday, spurred on by a settlement of legal action with Central Bore Nickel NL.
Centennial makes 60 cents a share offer for AQC before Thursday market open.
